[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]}} |armament=None |equipment=None |affiliation=*[[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family]] *[[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] {{C|briefly}} *[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] *[[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] *[[Delegation of 2000]] *[[House of Antilles]] *[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] *[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] *[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] *[[Five Worlds]] *[[Confederation]] *[[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]{{Film|VI}} *[[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] }} {{Quote|I am C-3PO, human-cyborg relations.|C-3PO|[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' (novel)]]}} '''C-3PO''', sometimes spelled '''See-Threepio''' and often referred to as '''Threepio''', was a bipedal, [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] designed to interact with [[Sentience/Legends|organics]], [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] primarily for etiquette and protocol. He was fluent in over six million forms of [[Language/Legends|communication]], and developed a fussy and worry-prone personality throughout his many [[Time/Legends|decades]] of operation. After being destroyed and discarded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] before [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], C-3PO was rebuilt; his salvaged nature gave him special qualities that distinguished him from similar [[Droid/Legends|droid]] models. Along with his [[Counterpart/Legends|counterpart]], the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], C-3PO constantly found himself directly involved in pivotal moments of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]], and aided in saving the galaxy on many occasions. C-3PO considered various droids and organics to be friends of his, and was very dedicated to them, as well as to any master that he served. Originally activated on [[Affa/Legends|Affa]] in [[112 BBY]], C-3PO had served as a protocol droid to the emissary of the [[Manakron system/Legends|Manakron system]]. Nearly [[32 BBY/Legends|eighty years later]], he was gutted and discarded on the streets of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of Tatooine. After being rebuilt by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], C-3PO served Skywalker and his mother [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]] for over ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]], performing household chores and helping Skywalker earn his freedom by [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|winning]] a [[Podracing/Legends|pod race]]. Skywalker left Tatooine but returned in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] when his mother [[Death/Legends|passed away]], and C-3PO was given to Skywalker, now a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], by Shmi's stepson [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]. C-3PO, Skywalker, R2-D2, and the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] immediately became embroiled in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a galaxy-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Skywalker [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|married]] Amidala and gave C-3PO to her as a [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] gift, and C-3PO faithfully assisted her in her senatorial duties throughout the three-year conflict. The two often entered the front lines of the war, at times fighting alongside Skywalker and R2-D2. At the end of the war, Skywalker became a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], Amidala passed away, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminated]], and the Republic was reorganized into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. C-3PO's memory was erased, however R2-D2's memory was not. C-3PO and R2-D2 were assigned to the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where they served Alderaan's [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] for nineteen years. They were, however, separated from Organa during that time period, and got caught up in a wide variety of misadventures, ruining the [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Tig Fromm]], helping restore the [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] [[King/Legends|monarchy]], and aiding the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]] in reviving [[Baobab family|his family's]] fortune, among other exploits. After rejoining the crew of the ''Tantive IV'' and serving under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], they became embroiled in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] entrusted them to bring a copy of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on Tatooine. After meeting Skywalker's son [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the droids helped rescue [[Prince/Legends|princess]] Leia from the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] and became directly attached to the three [[Human/Legends|Humans]], helping them and their rebellion defeat the Empire and restore freedom to the galaxy. When the Rebellion became a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], C-3PO continued to serve Luke and the now-married Han and Leia Solo, helping them defeat remnants of the Empire. Notably, C-3PO helped the [[Solo family/Legends|Solos]] raise their three children, and aided Luke in recruiting trainees for his [[New Jedi Order]]. His [[Translator/Legends|translation]] abilities proved crucial during major incidents on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Teljkon Vagabond]]'', and in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], and in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], he and R2-D2 teamed up with a young [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named [[Cole Fardreamer]] to foil a [[Almanian Uprising|plan]] to bomb the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Species/Legends|race]] of religious zealots known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded the galaxy in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], C-3PO participated in the four-year [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conflict]] that eventually saw the invaders defeated. The destruction wrought by the invaders, and particularly their harsh treatment of droids, caused C-3PO to deeply question his views on deactivation, immortality, and [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory erasure]]. [[41 ABY|Twelve years later]], he began helping raise the latest addition to the Solo/Skywalker clan: the spritely youth [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]]. ==Biography== ===Life on Tatooine=== ====Original activations==== {{Quote|I didn't have many friends when I was a kid, so I built one.|Anakin Skywalker to Padmé Amidala|[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]}} [[File:3PO_programming.png|thumb|left|250px|C-3PO being programmed by Anakin Skywalker]] C-3PO was originally activated on the [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] foundry [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Affa/Legends|Affa]] in the year [[112 BBY]]. Sometime in his early existence, he had served as a protocol droid to the emissary of the [[Manakron system/Legends|Manakron system]].{{TCW|Evil Plans}} Nearly [[32 BBY/Legends|eighty years later]], his head and gutted chassis had been discarded in a street of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and were discovered by two [[Human/Legends|Human]] youths, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]]. A poor [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], Skywalker decided to rebuild the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] C-3PO to [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|his home]] piece by piece.{{Tales|6|Thank the Maker}} Due to this hodgepodge reconstruction, C-3PO had more mechanical similarities to the [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series protocol droid]] than to his original model.''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' Skywalker's intention was that the reactivated [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] would function as a servant to [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his mother]], helping her with chores around the house while he worked at a nearby [[Wald's Parts|junk shop.]] C-3PO's [[gyro-balance circuitry]] was several decades old, but Skywalker used scrounged and improvised replacement parts to make the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] functional again. C-3PO boasted sound wiring, as well as a standard protocol droid [[Verbobrain/Legends|verbobrain]] and [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|communicator module]], but Skywalker could not afford even the simplest of droid coverings, and as such, left the droid's wiring exposed. C-3PO's salvaged nature imbued special qualities in him that were absent from other protocol droids. Skywalker sometimes brought C-3PO with him when bartering with nearby [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], and employed the droid's fluency in over six million [[Language/Legends|forms of communication]] after discovering a wounded [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]]. With the assistance of C-3PO's translation, Skywalker nursed the Tusken Raider back to health, although the Raider grew annoyed with the protocol droid and roared at him to "shut up." This rather offended C-3PO. ====Race for freedom==== [[File:C3POnaked-R2D2aF.png|thumb|right|180px|C-3PO lacked proper plating in his early years of operation.]] {{Quote|He's perfect.|Padmé Amidala after meeting C-3PO|}} When Skywalker met several off-worlders in the shop of his owner, the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], he invited them to the safety of his home as refuge from a coming sandstorm. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were brought to the slave quarters that Skywalker shared with his mother, Shmi, and Amidala and R2-D2 were introduced to C-3PO. Upon meeting R2-D2, C-3PO was shocked when the candid astromech droid commented that he was "naked." Despite the exchange, the two droids fast developed a friendship of sorts, working together to help Skywalker make final adjustments to [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|his podracer]] in time to race it in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|race]]. While working on the [[Podracer/Legends|racer]], the two droids discussed [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel and noted the clumsy actions of Binks. On the day of the race, C-3PO represented his owner in the opening flag parade, carrying Skywalker's flag onto [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|the course]] prior to the race. He then stood on the sidelines with R2-D2 and two of Skywalker's playmates, Banai and [[W. Wald]], who cheered their friend on. Skywalker won the race, which, thanks to a deal that Jinn had struck with Watto, earned the boy his freedom from slavery and secured Jinn the [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|hyperdrive generator]] he needed to leave the planet. As Skywalker prepared to depart Tatooine, he said his goodbyes to C-3PO, apologizing for not having completed the droid's construction, and expressing his wish that Shmi wouldn't sell him. Soon afterwards, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched a [[Unidentified young new recruit|Jedi recruit]] to Tatooine to program stories into C-3PO's memory. The young Jedi programmed several tales or anecdotes related to Skywalker, Queen Amidala and the Jedi.''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]'' Despite this fact, C-3PO would claim that he never was good at storytelling.{{Film|IV}} ====A new home, an old friend==== {{Quote|Hello. How might I be of service? I am See—''"
"''Threepio?|C-3PO and Skywalker reunited|{{Film|II}}}} [[File:EpII3po.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Shmi Skywalker covered C-3PO with dull grey platings.]][[30 BBY/Legends|Two years later]], Shmi covered C-3PO with heavily tarnished silver plating so that he might last longer in Tatooine's sandy environment. In another [[27 BBY/Legends|three years]], Shmi, who was still in Watto's possession, was sold to [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived with his son [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] on a [[Lars homestead/Legends|farm]] in the [[Great Chott salt flat/Legends|Great Chott salt flat]] near the city of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. Lars [[Marriage/Legends|married]] Shmi and freed her from her bonds; Shmi brought C-3PO with her, and the droid served the Lars family at their home for another five years.''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], shortly after Shmi was kidnapped by a group of Tusken Raiders, C-3PO was working on a moisture vaporator on the property when Skywalker, now a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], arrived with Amidala, now a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He initially didn't recognize Skywalker until the latter finished his name for him when introducing himself. Greeting his Maker, C-3PO discovered that Skywalker had come in search of his mother, and brought the two guests into the homestead's courtyard, where they were met by Owen and Cliegg Lars, as well as Owen's girlfriend, [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Whitesun]]. Learning of his mother's peril, Skywalker took Owen's [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]][[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]] to find her, and soon returned with her corpse, having recovered it from a [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|Tusken village]]. C-3PO was present when he arrived, and later attended a [[Funeral of Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|funeral for Shmi]] on the farm's property. When R2-D2, who had been waiting aboard [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|Amidala's nearby yacht]], interrupted the funeral with an urgent message for the Padawan, C-3PO translated the astromech's [[Binary/Legends|binary]] beeps and whistles. After viewing the [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] message, Skywalker and Amidala prepared to depart Tatooine for [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue Skywalker's Jedi Master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and Owen gave C-3PO to Skywalker as a parting gift. ===Entering the Clone Wars=== ====The Battle of Geonosis==== {{Quote|Oh, there's been some terrible mistake! I'm programmed for etiquette, not destruction!|C-3PO during the Battle of Geonosis|}} Landing the senator's [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] inside an exhaust vent on Geonosis, Skywalker and Amidala set out, leaving the droids behind. R2-D2 insisted on following them, but C-3PO disagreed and claimed to be in charge. The astromech droid ignored his friend and set out, and C-3PO reluctantly followed. Within the planet's [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]], [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]] swarmed by the droids in a flight from Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]; the droids soon discovered an entrance to a [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|battle droid factory]], within which Skywalker and Amidala were battling Geonosian warriors. As C-3PO viewed the scene before him in awe, he found the concept of "machines making machines" quite perverse, but was knocked off of the platform on which he stood by R2-D2 before he could comment further. With C-3PO out of his way, R2-D2 activated his [[Rocket booster/Legends|booster jets]] and soared through the factory in an effort to protect Amidala. C-3PO, meanwhile, tumbled onto a moving platform, but was tossed off by a large droid's mechanical arm. After landing on a conveyor belt, he righted himself and walked along the belt's length before his head was knocked off by moving machinery. His head landed on a conveyor belt which carried the heads of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], and his body wandered onto a separate belt which carried the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]' bodies. Unaware of the mix-up, the machines continued their construction, which resulted in C-3PO's head being grafted to a battle droid's body, and his body receiving a battle droid's head. [[File:3POGeonosis.jpg|thumb|right|250px|C-3PO unwittingly participated in the Battle of Geonosis.]] Both incarnations of C-3PO joined a force of B1 battle droids that soon marched into a Geonosian [[Petranaki arena|execution arena]]. Once inside, the droids surrounded a strike force of [[Jedi assault team/Legends|200 Jedi]] that had arrived to rescue Skywalker, Amidala, and Kenobi, all of whom had been captured and scheduled for [[Death/Legends|execution]]. Fighting in the name of the Separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the battle droids [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|attacked the Jedi]]; the battle droid head grafted to C-3PO's body found itself unable to properly fight, while C-3PO's head was very unnerved by its autonomous body, and apologized to any Jedi that the body fired its [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] at. However, both incarnations soon suffered a mix-up of programming: C-3PO's body fired several shots from his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]] until a bolt deflected by a Human Jedi separated it from its battle droid head; the protocol droid's head screamed insults at the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] that its battle droid body fired [[Laser/Legends|laser]] blasts at. The Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] neutralized the threat posed by the latter incarnation, however, by [[Telekinesis/Legends|using]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to knock it onto the arena floor, where a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] fell on top of it, effectively putting it out of the battle. R2-D2 entered the melee and used his cable gun to detach C-3PO's head from its battle droid body, before dragging it across the arena and reattaching it to the correct torso. As the remaining battle droids overwhelmed the Jedi, the Jedi Master Yoda arrived with a large force of the newly commissioned [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and the fighting spilled out of the arena, soon leaving R2-D2, C-3PO, and the young [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] as its sole occupants. C-3PO then commented to R2-D2 about the events he had endured being "the most peculiar dream." The Republic Army soon won the battle, launching a [[Clone Wars/Legends|galactic war]] between the Republic and the Confederacy. Shortly after the battle, R2-D2 and C-3PO accompanied Amidala and Skywalker back to Naboo, where they were the lone witnesses to a [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|wedding between the two]] in the planet's [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]]. ====From silver to gold==== {{Quote|In the service of a senator, one must be presentable.|C-3PO on his new gold plating|{{CW|21}}}} [[File:Droidsinblizzard2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|C-3PO and R2-D2 follow Amidala into an Ilum blizzard.]] C-3PO was given to Senator Amidala as a wedding gift from Skywalker, and the droid would go on to serve as Amidala's personal protocol droid throughout most of the Clone Wars. When on Naboo, the senator often assigned C-3PO to assist the Naboo Royal Council.''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' Early in the war, C-3PO was on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and along with the senator and R2-D2, witnessed Skywalker depart the planet in a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] on his way to [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|lay siege]] to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].{{CW|1}} Following the [[Battle of Ohma-D'un|defense of Naboo]] and the [[Swamp gas|bio-plague]] of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] unleashed by the Confederacy, Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] appointed C-3PO to serve as liaison to the Jedi during the remainder of that campaign.''[[Star Wars: Republic: The New Face of War]]'' Later, C-3PO and R2-D2 were traveling with Amidala in her yacht while the ship was host to Yoda. After Yoda convinced Amidala and her head of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]], to make a detour, the ship headed to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] on a rescue mission of the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her Padawan [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]].{{CW|15}} Yoda set out into the planet's blizzard alone, causing some worry on Amidala's part. Although C-3PO assured her that it was safer to remain at the ship, the senator set out into the blizzard, and ordered the two droids to follow her. After being ambushed by three [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] Separatist [[Chameleon droid/Legends|Chameleon droids]], Amidala destroyed all three by using her cloak and C-3PO as decoys to attract blaster fire. Despite being in the vicinity of the explosion of a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] thrown by Amidala, C-3PO remained unscathed, and the victorious trio were greeted by their three wayward Jedi.{{CW|16}} [[File:Threepio-Departure.png|thumb|right|150px|C-3PO received gold platings during the early stages of the Clone Wars.]] After returning to Coruscant, C-3PO received new [[Bronzium/Legends|gold]] platings to replace his dull silver ones. Afterwards, he and Amidala, both disguised in hooded cloaks, were walking in [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant's undercity]] when the senator disappeared. Searching for her, C-3PO was pulled into an alleyway by Skywalker, who had been engaging in a private rendezvous with Amidala. After being told by the Padawan that he looked different, C-3PO removed his cloak and revealed his new plating. Skywalker was promptly [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] and summoned by Obi-Wan Kenobi, and was subsequently granted the title of Jedi Knight. Free of his [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]], he gave the hairpiece to C-3PO to present to Amidala as a gift. Amidala returned the favor by giving R2-D2 to Skywalker, separating the two droids once more. When [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the Confederacy, arranged for [[Rotta/Legends|the son]] of the notorious [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to be kidnapped, the Republic feared that Jabba would blame the Jedi and in turn allow the Confederacy access to [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Amidala offered to parley with Jabba's uncle [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]], but ended up a captive in [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|the Hutt's Coruscant palace]] after discovering that Ziro was in league with Dooku. Before being imprisoned, the senator contacted C-3PO and called for help; the protocol droid in turn brought a contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|Ziro's palace]], who [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|captured]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and freed Amidala. C-3PO was relieved that his timing had been perfect.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] ====In the thick of the fighting==== {{Quote|I do believe I'm lost. In enemy territory. And all alone.|C-3PO aboard the ''Malevolence''|{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}}} While Skywalker was leading a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|warships]] against the Separatist [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], C-3PO was in [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|Amidala's apartment]], aiding the Senator and Jar Jar Binks in sifting through [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] for any mention of the cruiser or its fate. Minus Binks, the group took Amidala's yacht to a point in space near the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] to contact a member of the Separatist-allied [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] who had sued for peace. With the senator focused on the mission, C-3PO set the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] course and filed away several messages that had arrived from [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] via the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].''[[The Clone Wars: Agenda]]'' When the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] exited hyperspace, the two found themselves caught in a trap, as Dooku had arranged for them to arrive immediately adjacent to the crippled ''Malevolence'', which was incapable of hyperspace travel after being battered by Skywalker's fleet. The yacht became trapped in the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], but Amidala set the yacht's engines to destroy themselves as she and C-3PO sneaked out of their ship and onto the ''Malevolence''. [[File:Destroy_Malevolence.jpg|thumb|left|250px|C-3PO and Amidala are attacked by battle droids aboard the ''Malevolence''.]] Following the yacht's explosion, C-3PO and Amidala made their way through the cruiser's corridors, and attempted to get a broken comm panel working in order to contact Skywalker's fleet. After the squad passed, Amidala contacted Skywalker, who had boarded the ''Malevolence'' along with Kenobi and R2-D2. They agreed to meet amidst the cruiser's [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jet]] system; when C-3PO and Amidala arrived, they were accosted by battle droids, which prompted the senator to push the protocol droid into a moving [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]]. C-3PO and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] Binks began to prepare her [[J-type star skiff|star skiff]] for takeoff from a landing platform when they were approached by the [[Con artist/Legends|con men]] [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]] and [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]], who were posing as Republic [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]]. C-3PO calmly acquiesced when the scammers claimed that they were commandeering the skiff for "government business," but before the droid could disengage the ship's [[Autopilot/Legends|autopilot]], Binks mistakenly caused the entire platform to flip upside-down. The Gungan quickly righted the platform, but the confusion caused C-3PO to forget to turn the autopilot off, which ultimately caused Faytonni and Med-Beq to be taken directly to the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] that they had been fleeing from. With the skiff gone, C-3PO and Binks prepped Amidala's new yacht instead.''[[The Clone Wars: Departure]]'' When the trio [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|took the yacht]] to Rodia's [[Senatorial Palace/Legends|Senatorial Palace]], C-3PO and Binks were instructed to remain at its landing platform while Amidala conducted talks with Senator Farr. The unintentional machinations of the clumsy Gungan then set off a series of events: the yacht's [[Entry ramp/Legends|hatch]] closed, C-3PO became stuck to a [[Magnetic hoist/Legends|magnetic hoist]] that swung into and destroyed the battle droids, and an [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droid]] arrived before plummeting off of the landing platform into [[Water/Legends|water]] with Binks atop it. Still stuck to the [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] hoist, C-3PO lamented what he believed to be the Gungan's death, before Binks climbed back onto the platform and released the droid from his magnetism. His next clumsy action was to crush and destroy the yacht with the hoist, however. As the two scoured what remained of the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], Binks discovered a Jedi-esque cloak and rushed off to save Amidala, whom they deduced had been taken hostage by Separatist forces.{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}} [[File:Bombad_bg.jpg|thumb|right|250px|C-3PO and Jar Jar Binks plan a rescue of Amidala on Rodia.]] As C-3PO reluctantly followed the Gungan, they were spotted by the droid escort of Viceroy Gunray, who mistook Binks for a Jedi and chased him off. C-3PO surrendered, and was sent to a dismantling center on the orders of the Viceroy. En route, the two battle droids assigned to escort C-3PO were destroyed by an escaped Amidala, who quickly ordered the protocol droid to locate a comm center and send a distress signal to any nearby Republic forces. Discovering such a center, C-3PO told its battle droid guards that the "Jedi" had been spotted, resulting in them rushing to subdue it. C-3PO then accessed a secure military frequency and contacted a clone trooper, before being arrested by two new battle droids and being brought to Amidala, who had also been re-captured. As Gunray prepared to order the two to be shot by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], Binks arrived with a [[Bogey (Kwazel Maw)/Legends|Kwazel Maw]], a [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|large sea creature]] that he had befriended; the creature easily routed the battle droids present before Senator Farr turned on Gunray and arrested him in the name of the Republic. Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]] and [[Green Company/Legends|his forces]] then arrived to apprehend the Viceroy, and C-3PO found himself impressed that the Gungan's foolishness had saved the day. ====A white truce, a blue shadow==== {{Quote|With your permission, Senator Padmé, I would like to shut down before I get sensory overload.''"
"''Permission denied.|C-3PO and Amidala, while analyzing a captured Separatist tactical droid on Naboo|{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}}} C-3PO was again reunited with R2-D2 during a trip to [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], when Amidala lent the protocol droid to Skywalker for the mission to the icy world. When the Jedi discovered that the clone troopers stationed on Pantora had been wiped out by a group of local [[Talz/Legends|Talz]], C-3PO and Cho joined them in meeting with [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]], the Talz's tribal leader. C-3PO translated as Thi-Sen welcomed Cho in peace, and when Cho responded by angrily declaring [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|war]] on the natives. When the droid awoke but found itself without the use of its [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], C-3PO convinced it that it was aboard a Separatist ship, and gleaned that there was a secret lab producing some sort of virus before Binks's clumsiness destroyed the droid. Binks, however, had found an [[Insect/Legends|insect]] inside the droid that he identified as coming from Naboo's [[Eastern swamps/Legends|Eastern swamps]]; the entire party contacted Jedi Masters Yoda and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to request the aid of Skywalker and Kenobi. C-3PO and Typho remained in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to attempt to uncover data from other captured battle droids while Amidala and Binks left to scout the swamps, and discovered a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] inside a B1's head. Joined by the Gungan [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]], who had discovered traces of the deadly [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] in a nearby river, they greeted Skywalker, Kenobi, Skywalker's Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and R2-D2 as they arrived on-planet, and showed them the hologram before the Jedi set out to discover [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|Vindi's laboratory]]. The mad doctor was synthesizing an airborne strain of the virus, but the Jedi and their clone troopers subdued him and prevented it from escaping his laboratory.{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}} ====Intrigue in the Senate==== {{Quote|It seems no one wants my company tonight.|C-3PO on Cato Neimoidia, following several dismissals by Humans|{{TCW|Senate Spy}}}} Shortly after the blue shadow crisis, C-3PO was back on Coruscant, and accompanied Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to [[Padmé's office/Legends|Amidala's office]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. The two escorted Amidala to the lobby of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], where the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] Senator [[Philo/Legends|Philo]] had called a meeting of important senators in anticipation of a vote on the proposed [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]]. The meeting was [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|interrupted]], however, by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and several other [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], who took the senators and their aides hostage in a bid to force a pardon for Ziro the Hutt. Bane shot and killed Philo, and his companions subdued Skywalker, who had been elsewhere in the Senate Building at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. After an unconscious Skywalker was brought to the group of hostages, the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters left, but rigged a system of lasers that would trigger planted explosives with the slightest touch. After regaining consciousness, Skywalker used his lightsaber to cut a hole around the group, dropping them to safety in the room below just before Bane remotely activated the explosives.{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}} [[File:Advicefromthemaster.png|thumb|right|300px|C-3PO advises Amidala and Rush Clovis on Cato Neimoidia.]] C-3PO remained on Coruscant for some time afterwards, and when Skywalker arrived at Amidala's apartment to surprise his wife with dinner, the protocol droid warmly greeted his Maker before being promptly ignored and subsequently dismissed by Amidala. The married couple were soon sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] along with Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] of the Banking Clan, and brought C-3PO and R2-D2 with them. Amidala would parley with Senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the Trade Federation while simultaneously spying on Clovis, as both Dod and Clovis were suspected of being in league with the Confederacy. After Amidala's star skiff landed outside of [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|Dod's Palace]], C-3PO accompanied Amidala and Clovis as they greeted the Neimoidian Senator, but soon found himself largely unneeded; he was dismissed by Clovis for the night following dinner, and retired to the quarters that Amidala had been assigned. There he found an agitated Skywalker, who quickly left after being commed by his wife. Amidala was soon [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by Dod, and was brought to her quarters by Clovis to be attended to by C-3PO and a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]]; Skywalker sought an antidote to her poison and brought her to the palace's lobby to confront Dod, and was followed by C-3PO and Clovis. When Clovis threatened Dod's life, C-3PO accepted the antidote from one of Dod's aides. With the antidote and a datacard that Amidala had obtained that implicated Clovis in a Separatist scheme procured, Skywalker, Amidala, and the droids left the planet, leaving Clovis at the mercy of the Trade Federation. Remaining at Amidala's side, C-3PO accompanied her and Kenobi in the senator's [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] within the Senate's [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] as Amidala presented evidence to the gathered senators that revealed the wishes of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] that his planet remain neutral in the war. With the evidence in front of them, the Senate rescinded an earlier vote that had called for Republic occupation of the planet.{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}} Shortly thereafter, Amidala and some of her allies in the Senate introduced a [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|bill]] proposing the cutting of [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] spending, believing that diplomacy was the solution to war. C-3PO attended several meetings of the informal coalition in Amidala's office, and accompanied his master as she spoke to the Senate regarding their views. While he was serving drinks at one such meeting, Senator Farr of Rodia suffered what appeared to be a [[Heart/Legends|heart]] attack and died. C-3PO attended [[Funeral of Onaconda Farr/Legends|his funeral]], and Amidala and Senator Organa soon after discovered that he had been poisoned by his aide [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]].{{TCW|Senate Murders}} [[File:C3POR2D2zillo.jpg|thumb|left|300px|C-3PO and R2-D2 escape from the rampaging Zillo Beast on Coruscant.]] When a massive [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] was brought to Coruscant following its [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|discovery]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] by Skywalker and Mace Windu, opinions on what to do with the creature differed greatly within the small circle of those who knew of its existence. Amidala caught wind of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] plan to kill the beast, and invited Skywalker and Kenobi to meet her and C-3PO in the Senate building. Skywalker arrived with R2-D2, who C-3PO greeted and ensured was staying out of trouble. The Senator convinced her husband to appeal to his friend Palpatine, and the droids joined their masters in appearing before Palpatine in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]]. As Skywalker and Amidala discussed their options with Palpatine and [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], the Zillo Beast meanwhile escaped from its captivity and charged through Coruscant's cityscape. Amidala assigned C-3PO to evacuate the staff of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]], and after he had completed the task, the beast reached the Chancellor's office. Amedda had previously excused himself from the discussion, but Palpatine, Skywalker, Amidala, R2-D2, and C-3PO evacuated through an emergency escape route and boarded an executive ship [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a [[Unidentified Senate Commando (Zillo Beast incident)/Legends|Senate Commando]]. As the commando took the ship into the air, it was grabbed by one of the Zillo Beast's massive hands.{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}} Skywalker used his lightsaber to cleave the ship clean in half, sending the bow and all six passengers sliding down the exterior of the Senate Rotunda. C-3PO landed atop R2-D2, who had attached himself to the side of the building with a [[Power harpoon launcher|tow cable]], but the astromech droid soon disengaged himself from the cable and used his booster rockets to make his way over to Palpatine and fly the Chancellor to safety. C-3PO lost hold of the cable and fell to the ground, but clone troopers in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] used [[Gas bomb/Legends|gas bombs]] to kill the creature and end the threat it posed to Coruscant's [[Coruscanti/Legends|citizens]]. The poison they emitted was [[Force barrier/Legends|held back]] with the Force by Skywalker, as well as Yoda and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who had been attempting to engage the beast. C-3PO, R2-D2, Palpatine, Amidala, and the three Jedi remained safe from the poison gas. The following morning, the entire party was present as the Zillo Beast's corpse was taken away from the scene. ====Peculiar peril==== {{Quote|Hey Shiny! You two finished with those repairs on the computer system?''"
"''My good sir. You may not realize it, but we have been on quite an adventure.|A clone trooper and C-3PO, while on Aleena|{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}}}} C-3PO and R2-D2 were later dispatched on a [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|mercy mission]] to [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] alongside the clone trooper [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]]. A series of deadly [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] had shaken the planet, and C-3PO's role in the relief team was to act as a translator between the clones and the native [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]]. The group rode LAATs into a ruined city, where they were greeted by the Aleena [[King/Legends|King]] [[Manchucho/Legends|Manchucho]]. He heralded their arrival as a sign that the "[[Deity/Legends|Gods]] below" would once more know peace. A brief aftershock then rumbled through the ground, and C-3PO's insistence that the Aleena remain calm earned him a cheer from the delighted locals. While R2-D2 left to download information on the delivered equipment into the [[Aleen mainframe station/Legends|mainframe computer station]], C-3PO remained with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], who was overseeing the setup of temporary [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]] and kitchens. However, Manchucho refused the kitchen, insisting that the relief team first needed to "make peace in the ground." C-3PO soon left Wolffe's side to seek out R2-D2, who was finishing his download in a destroyed building. A small group of Aleena were insistent that the two droids come and see something, and C-3PO and R2-D2 followed them to a large hole in the ground that was mostly covered by a [[Jedi chapter house (Aleen)/Legends|heavy seal]]. C-3PO was sent tumbling into the hole by another aftershock, and R2-D2 followed his friend down with the aid of his booster rockets. [[File:Epguide405.jpg|thumb|right|300px|C-3PO and R2-D2 meet the Kindalo.]] After landing in a dark, [[Aleen Underworld|subterranean cavern]], the droids sought a way out with the aid of R2-D2's [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]]. What C-3PO initially took to be daylight ahead turned out to be phosphorescent plants in the midst of an underground forest. C-3PO was then surrounded by what appeared to be glowing insects, but the pests were shooed by R2-D2's [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|fire extinguishing foam]]. However, the action caused several of the forest's [[Tree/Legends|trees]] to stand up and encircle the droids. Actually members of the [[Kindalo/Legends|Kindalo]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they demanded to know why the droids had come and why the surface dwellers has disturbed their peace. C-3PO began to explain himself, and [[Unidentified Kindalo 2/Legends|one Kindalo]] revealed that the ground had shaken in order to keep the deadly surface air out of the underground. When C-3PO offered to help solve their problem, he was directed to see someone called [[Orphne/Legends|Orphne]], and he and R2-D2 quickly departed. Inside a chamber, the glowing insects reappeared and [[Metamorphosis|metamorphosed]] into a [[Orphne's species/Legends|radiant female being]]: Orphne. Orphne told of an ancient covenant between the Aleena and the subterranean dwellers that had recently been broken by the movement of poisonous surface air to their world that did not go through the natural filtering process. The underground dwellers had caused the groundquakes in retaliation. Eager to prevent more Aleena deaths, C-3PO offered to seal the breach, but the mysterious Orphne disappeared after leaving them with a riddle: "You can run but can not walk. You have a mouth but cannot talk. You have a head but never weep. You have a bed but never sleep. Ask yourself, who are you?" C-3PO bid R2-D2 to play back the riddle one more time and then pondered its meaning. Unbeknownst to the protocol droid, R2-D2 found several circles on the floor that were decorated with symbols representing the four elements. When he sprayed some water on the appropriate circle, it helped C-3PO solve the riddle—a river. The chamber's central circle then rose into the air on a jet of water and carried both droids back to Aleen's surface. Both droids were launched high into the air and sent crashing down next to the hole through which they had initially fallen. Toxic underground air was rising through the breach and causing nearby Aleena to cough, which prompted R2-D2 to pull on it with his cable gun. C-3PO added his own strength by pushing, and the droids sealed the hole. The two worlds were once more separated. At that moment, several clone troopers arrived; skeptical of C-3PO's claims of an adventure, they escorted the droids back to the LAATs. Manchucho thanked C-3PO for his help, and the group launched to return to their ship and proceed to a rendezvous with Jedi Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]. [[File:Lilliputians.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The droids encounter the pint-sized Patitites.]] While traveling aboard [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|Gallia's ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''en route'' to Republic space, C-3PO communicated with a holographic image of Amidala that was displayed by R2-D2. She told the protocol droid that he was needed back on Coruscant, but that plan was curtailed by the [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|arrival]] of a Separatist fleet. An evacuation was ordered after the ''Venator''{{'s}} [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]] was hit and a Separatist attack force boarded the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. In a corridor, C-3PO and R2-D2 saw General Grievous engage Master Gallia in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], and they consequently fled in search of an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. When they ended up in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], C-3PO reluctantly followed R2-D2 into a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]], which the astromech operated from the droid socket and piloted out into the unfolding space battle. R2-D2 destroyed one Separatist [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid]] but eventually took them to the nearby planet [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] when the ''Venator'' was turned into stellar debris. A pursuing vulture droid knocked out the fighter's reactor, but when it lost them in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere's]] cloud cover, R2-D2 brought the Y-wing around behind it and destroyed it. The Y-wing's reactor then shut down, and the droids crash-landed into a marsh.{{TCW|Nomad Droids}} After climbing out of the damaged ship, C-3PO and R2-D2 were charged at by the world's natives: the diminutive [[Patitite/Legends|Patitites]], who stood less than half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall. The droids' dismissal of them as a threat was countered by strikes from the Patitites' [[Powered spear/Legends|powered spears]], which produced electrical currents and knocked both droids to the ground. C-3PO and R2-D2 were both then tied to the ground and told of the virtues of the Big [[Hay-Zu/Legends|Hay-Zu]], their leader. Hay-Zu soon arrived on the scene and banished them from the planet, but when the droids were cut loose, an offended R2-D2 approached the Patitite leader with the intention of fighting. C-3PO tried to intervene but ended up inadvertently knocking the astromech down and turning Hay-Zu into a pile of goo. Free from their leaders' despotism, the Patitites cheered his conquerors and set to work helping R2-D2 fix the Y-wing. Several of them asked C-3PO to be their new leader, but he instead decided to introduce them to democracy. [[Unidentified Patitite/Legends|The]] [[Unidentified Patitite 2/Legends|three]] [[Unidentified Patitite 3/Legends|smartest]] and most compassionate Patitites were brought forward, with the new leader to be chosen by way of applause, but squabbling broke out between the divided crowd. C-3PO and R2-D2 quickly boarded the repaired starfighter and left the Patitites to their new democracy, knocking them all over with the backwash of the ship's [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] in the process. During their flight from Patitite Patuna, the droids realized that ship and occupants alike were running out of power. They accordingly touched down on the nearby planet of [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]], and a frightened C-3PO followed his companion into the fog after R2-D2 scanned for a viable power source. However, a group of [[Balnab (group)/Legends|Balnab]] hunters quickly found them and ensnared them in a [[Net/Legends|net]]. The two droids were brought to a clearing surrounded by canyon walls, where an enormous hologram of [[Albee Dewaw/Legends|Albee Dewaw]]—a being of the [[Unidentified tentacle-faced species/Legends|same species]] as most of the Balnab hunters—killed one of his underlings with a bolt of lightning for daring to show independent thought by bringing non-living things before him. C-3PO did not hesitate to point out that he was a hologram, and Dewaw responded by sending more lightning bolts striking the ground around the protocol droid. Meanwhile, R2-D2 discovered a hidden room in a canyon wall and learned that Dewaw was nothing more than a false being projected by four [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] at computers. When he shoved [[Unidentified DUM-series pit droid (Balnab)/Legends|one of the droids]] out into the open, the ruse was revealed and the Balnab hunters stormed the hidden room. A [[lightfight]] ensued, and C-3PO and R2-D2 walked away from the ensuing explosions that rocked the canyon. [[File:TheseAreNotTheDroidsYouAreLookingFor-TCWND.jpg|thumb|right|300px|C-3PO and R2-D2, briefly in Confederate custody]] The droids made their way back to the Y-wing but were forced to stop under a large mushroom as they both ran out of power. Not long afterward, a group of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] found them and brought droids and Y-wing alike aboard their pirate ship, the [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']]. C-3PO and R2-D2 were plugged in to recharge, but when they awoke, they were ushered into a droid fighting ring, where the [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series droid]] [[K0-5D/Legends|K0-5D]] was vanquishing all challengers with deadly [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. C-3PO and R2-D2 were forced into the ring but were saved by a [[Hull/Legends|hull]] breach when General Grievous's [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)/Legends|flagship]] arrived in-system and decided to use the ''Marauder'' as target practice. C-3PO grabbed hold of R2-D2 as the astromech used his booster rockets to carry them through space and safely take them to a hangar aboard Grievous's ship. A group of B1 battle droids immediately arrested them and sent them to the incinerator, where they were placed on a conveyor belt that began edging them toward their doom. However, a Republic fleet arrived at that moment and [[Rescue of Adi Gallia/Legends|attacked]], and R2-D2 rocketed both himself and C-3PO away from the incinerator in the midst of the chaos. They found both Adi Gallia and Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] destroying a small resistance force of battle droids, as Grievous had fled at the first sign of trouble. A stunned Commander Wolffe recognized C-3PO and R2-D2, and C-3PO regaled him with a tale of their adventures as the Republic forces returned to their fleet. ===War's end=== ====Last-ditch diplomacy==== {{Quote|I specifically told you two not to stray far from the palace.''"
"''It was all Artoo's fault.|Amidala and C-3PO, on Bri'ahl|{{CWACite|4|Another Fine Mess}}}} [[File:Briahls-AnotherFineMess.jpg|thumb|left|300px|By the end of the war, C-3PO was prone to losing his head.]] [[19 BBY/Legends|Three years into]] the war, Senator Amidala yet sought to entice neutral worlds to join the Republic, and she brought C-3PO and Captain Typho on a [[Mission to Bri'ahl|mission to the planet Bri'ahl]]. R2-D2 joined the trio, and as Amidala negotiated with President [[Vuul]], she told the droids to not stray too far from the [[Presidential palace (Bri'ahl)|Presidential Palace]]. Nevertheless, they took a ride on a [[Hoversled/Legends|Bri'ahlian Sky-sled]] and crashed into a forest. C-3PO's head was separated from its body, and after it argued with R2-D2 over whose fault the accident had been, the astromech left to retrieve the body. In his absence, a [[Bri'ahlian creature|green creature]] considered eating C-3PO's head but ultimately tossed it down the side of a hill. It rolled into a river, and R2-D2 arrived with C-3PO's body in tow to make a rescue. However, a [[Bri'ahlian mammoth|large mammoth]] was grazing by the river bank, and after an electrical charge from R2-D2, it swatted both droids high into the air. The droids' rough landing crushed three [[Bri'ahl (species)|Bri'ahlian]] rebels who had secretly thrown their lot in with Count Dooku. The rebels had outfitted their soldiers with clone trooper armor and planned to storm the Presidential Palace. C-3PO's head was hurriedly re-attached by R2-D2, and when the droids came across the faux-troopers, loose [[Servomotor/Legends|servomotors]] in C-3PO caused his hand to slap one trooper in the face. The rebel fell to the ground and accidentally blasted a companion, which led to a panic among the rebels and a round of blasting. A thermal detonator was thrown, and C-3PO and R2-D2 were suddenly the only ones left standing. Ignorant of the plot they had just foiled, they returned to the Palace, where Amidala berated them for being out too late. ====A hero's fall==== {{Quote|I feel so helpless.|C-3PO at the end of the Clone Wars|{{Film|III}}}} In the same year, the Republic chased the Confederacy from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|took the fight]] to their opponents in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Amidala's [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] of senators saw this as a cue for the Supreme Chancellor to relinquish his emergency powers, and scheduled an appointment with him to discuss the matter. C-3PO and Amidala joined their loyalist compatriots outside Palpatine's office, where they were dismissed by [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], one of his chief advisors. Despite this, the group waited for Palpatine to conclude a meeting with the rest of his inner circle, and was eventually welcomed in by the Chancellor. As Senator Organa requested that Palpatine overturn the [[Enhanced Security and Enforcement Act]] that allowed warrantless searches and seizures, the Chancellor told him to bring it before the Senate, and recognized C-3PO as having been built by Skywalker. C-3PO was honored that the Chancellor remembered him.''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' [[File:Seeds_of_Rebellion.jpg|thumb|right|225px|C-3PO serves drinks at a meeting of the Delegation of 2000.]] The distraction offered by the Outer Rim Sieges allowed the Separatists to launched a [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|siege of Coruscant]] and kidnap the Supreme Chancellor. During the battle, a hole was blown in the side of Amidala's apartment, causing a good deal of distress to C-3PO. His master was unfazed, however, and along with C-3PO and Typho's assistance, began evacuating the residents of the building.{{CW|23}} Afterwards, C-3PO and Amidala made their way to the Senate Rotunda and rendezvoused with Senators Organa and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], who were in the company of Jedi Masters [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]]. As Separatist vulture droids and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] flew through the planet's skyways and rained destruction down on the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] people, the two Jedi were searching for and attempting to protect the Chancellor. They offered Allie's [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] to the Senators and took off on Ti's speeder bike to Palpatine's residence at the [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] building. C-3PO and the senators boarded the skimmer, and Organa piloted it through thick traffic, but they were soon shot down by vulture droids and made a crash landing on a landing platform. After exiting the downed vehicle, Amidala and Organa used [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to keep vulture droids in patrol mode at bay in order to allow LAAT gunships clear shots at them, and the group then took refuge in the [[Embassy Mall]] shopping center. Civilians crowded the mall, and C-3PO conferred with a [[TC-16|silver protocol droid]], who warned him that dark times were ahead. He told C-3PO to accept a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] if it was ever offered, as the alternative would be living in confusion as the lines between good and evil were blurred. The silver droid departed, and C-3PO and Amidala watched on the Embassy's HoloNet monitor as General Grievous displayed the kidnapped Chancellor and proclaimed that the end of the Republic was at hand. Kenobi, Skywalker, and R2-D2 returned from the Outer Rim, however, boarded Grievous's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], killed Count Dooku and rescued the Chancellor; Grievous and the Separatist then fled the planet. C-3PO joined the Senate's [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] and Mace Windu in welcoming the day's heroes outside the Senate Building. After greeting R2-D2, C-3PO was entertained by the astromech's tales of the rescue. As Amidala grew more distressed by the increasing power held by Palpatine, she drafted a [[Delegation of 2000|petition]] asking him to lay down his emergency powers, and hosted other concerned senators at meetings in her apartment. During at least one such meeting, C-3PO served drinks to the gathered senators.{{Film|III}} deleted scenes The days after the Separatist attack were harrowing for both Amidala and Skywalker, and they ultimately saw the latter fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] under the influence of Palpatine, who was actually the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious and had been conspiring against the Jedi. As Jedi across the galaxy [[Order 66/Legends|were killed]], Skywalker, now known as Darth Vader, [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|brought]] the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of clone troopers to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and slaughtered all the Jedi present. As Amidala watched the temple burn from her apartment window, C-3PO contacted the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office of the Chancellor]] and learned that Skywalker had returned to the temple. Vader and R2-D2 then arrived at the apartment in Vader's [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Jedi starfighter]]; C-3PO briefly conversed with R2-D2 before Vader took the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where he killed the entire [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] and ended the war. After learning of his fall to the dark side from Kenobi, Amidala took C-3PO to Mustafar to see him; C-3PO piloted the skiff, allowing a reprieve for the distraught senator. [[File:Threepio-19bby.jpg|thumb|left|175px|C-3PO and Amidala at the end of the Clone Wars]] Unbeknownst to either of them, Kenobi stowed away aboard the skiff, and his arrival at Mustafar caused an enraged Vader to choke his wife with the Force. As he and Kenobi left the platform and [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|engaged]] in a lightsaber duel, C-3PO and R2-D2 brought Amidala back aboard the skiff and attempted to stabilize her condition. Kenobi soon returned, having defeated Vader, and piloted the skiff with C-3PO to the planetoid [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] to rendezvous with Yoda and Senator Bail Organa. Amidala was brought to a [[Polis Massa Research Base|medical center]], where C-3PO, R2-D2, Kenobi, Organa and Yoda bore witness to the birth of two twins she had been carrying: [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]]. Weakened and without the will to continue living, Amidala passed away on the operating table. As the five survivors brought her body to Naboo on Organa's [[CR70 corvette/Legends|corvette]], the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], Kenobi and Yoda discussed the situation with Organa: The Jedi Order had nearly been wiped out, and the Republic had been reorganized into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with Palpatine as its [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Yoda and Kenobi went into hiding, the latter watching over Luke, who was entrusted to the Lars family on Tatooine. Leia was adopted by Organa and [[Breha Organa/Legends|his wife]]; the twins would be kept safe from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the dark times ahead. Organa entrusted C-3PO and R2-D2 to [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], the Captain of the ''Tantive IV'', who was instructed to treat them well and, to C-3PO's horror, to wipe the protocol droid's memory. As Organa intended for the droids to one day belong to Leia, he knew that erasing all knowledge of the child's parents from C-3PO was the best way to keep the chatty droid from revealing her true parentage. 3PO ultimately pushed the memory wipe button himself to erase his own memory (also making sure to say goodbye to R2-D2 before going through with it), although he unintentionally ended up erasing an [[Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Sundered Heart)|RA-7 protocol droid]] who was guiding him through the process.{{SWComicCite|7.13|Memory Loss}} During his time with the Alderaanian royal family, C-3PO served for a time as the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} cook and maître d'.{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}} ===Early Imperial era=== ====Separated from the ''Tantive IV''==== {{Quote|Functioning without a master for even a short time makes one feel so… inadequate!|C-3PO|[[Droids (1986) 2|''Droids'' (1986) 2]]}} In the early years of the Empire's reign, the droid duo were in one of the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} escape pods while the ship's [[Chief Petty Officer/Legends|Chief Petty Officer]], [[Corla Metonae/Legends|Corla Metonae]], was supervising test launches of the pods{{DB|character|corlametonae|Metonae, Corla}} in the [[Karthakk system|Maramere system]]. The [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], a local pirate group, attacked{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}} the ''Tantive IV'', which was forced to flee and to abandon its jettisoned pods. Bail Organa made the finding of such valuable property an imperative priority, but the droids were captured by the Lok Revenants. They shared an adventure or two with the freebooters, but after suddenly finding themselves free of their captors, C-3PO and R2-D2 sought out employment with the [[Intergalactic Droid Agency]]. They were placed aboard a [[Intergalactic Droid Agency shuttle|shuttle]] en route to the planet [[Dodz]] to meet their new master: the crystal [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Lott Kemp]]. Aboard the shuttle, several other droids made disparaging wisecracks about the tiny world's barren landscape. After landing, the counterparts trekked to the address they had been given, only to find Kemp's home in ruins. A young Human male named [[Jost Ellon]] appeared with a blaster drawn, but when C-3PO explained himself, Ellon calmed down and revealed that Dodz's [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Kugg]] unleashed a massive [[Destroyer (droid)|Destroyer droid]] against any who refused to pay his exorbitant tax rates. Kemp had been the latest victim, although he had survived and gone missing. Ellon recruited C-3PO and R2-D2 to serve him and help him with lifting things; they then boarded [[Jost Ellon's landspeeder|Ellon's landspeeder]] and made their way to the boy's home.[[Droids (1986) 1|''Droids'' (1986) 1]] [[File:C3potakesabath.png|thumb|right|200px|Jost Ellon's Ranger X-1 shoves C-3PO into a tub of water.]] Having lost his family to the Kugg's Destroyer, Ellon lived in a modest cave dwelling scattered with technology that he scavenged and sold. C-3PO and R2-D2 discovered an old [[Ranger X-One defense robot]], which only activated when Ellon gave it a swift kick. The Ranger's power was almost depleted, but a reflexive shove that sent C-3PO tumbling into a tub of water was enough to convince Ellon that he now had the means with which to stand up to Kugg. The boy and his three droids raced to the main dwelling of the planet's [[Citizen's Council of Dodz|Citizen's Council]], only to find that Kugg had just terrorized them and forced them to pay triple what he had previously asked for. [[Head Councilman]] [[Althon]] had given up hope, but a [[Unidentified Human male (Dodz)|mysterious old man]] convinced Ellon to fight against Kugg's tyranny. C-3PO and R2-D2 accompanied Ellon as he journeyed to [[Kugg's mansion]] the next day with his Ranger, and when Kugg unleashed the Destroyer, a battle began. The Ranger gained the upper hand but quickly began to lose power; when Ellon tried to interfere, the Destroyer easily knocked him over. The Ranger only made it back into the fight when R2-D2 fired his cables at the droid and used himself as a medium through which to siphon power from the Destroyer to the Ranger. However, he overloaded, and although the Destroyer exploded, R2-D2 was left severely depleted of power. Kugg was taken into citizens' custody, and Ellon saw the droids safely aboard an Intergalactic Droid Agency shuttle that had been dispatched to retrieve them for repairs. It was bound for the [[Lonn Idd's repair station|droid repair station]] of the scientist [[Lonn Idd]], whom they hoped would repair R2-D2's microsynapse damage. When the [[Annoo-dat]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Tig Fromm]] came to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] to steal a powerful laser from Idd, C-3PO and R2-D2 helped Idd's children, [[Vik Idd|Vik]] and [[Nikki Idd|Nikki]], free the scientist; C-3PO donned the outer shell of a [[HK Guardian Droid|guardian droid]] and destroyed all of Fromm's [[hover guard]] droids, allowing Vik to trap Fromm in a [[packing net]] and turn him over to the authorities. Lonn Idd gratefully repaired R2-D2, and his children ferried both droids to a nearby Intergalactic Droid Agency station, where they were almost immediately purchased by [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Zell]] of [[Majoor]] and assigned to act as tutors and companions of Zell's son [[Llez]], who had dreams of dismantling C-3PO and using R2-D2 for entertainment purposes. During a diplomatic mission to [[Armath]] that saw Zell command a fleet of Majooran [[Consular ship/Legends|consular ships]], Llez fled from his father and took up with the pirate [[Reddjak]], but returned to his father when Reddjak was personally defeated by Zell.[[Droids (1986) 3|''Droids'' (1986) 3]] ====A wrinkle in time==== {{Quote|Too late, Artoo… He's disrupted the anti-matter pods!|C-3PO regarding Prince Plooz, just before traveling to the future|[[Droids (1986) 4|''Droids'' (1986) 4]]}} After vowing to take a more active role in raising his son, Zell realized that the droids' service was no longer needed. They were dismissed, and the Intergalactic Droid Agency arranged for their sale to an impoverished branch of the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]] in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]]. Their assignment was to be [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] couriers, which C-3PO believed would make them droids of distinction. When they arrived at the [[Royal Palace (Sooma)|Royal Palace]] of the planet [[Sooma]], they found that [[Plooz]]—son of King [[Gokus]] of nearby [[Alzar]]—had stowed away aboard a Sooman freighter and ended up in the court of Sooma's King [[Zornog]]. [[Sludd]], First General to Alzar's forces, had in fact concocted a scheme to overthrow his King, and had tricked Plooz into boarding the freighter. C-3PO and R2-D2 stopped a hyperactive Plooz from choking Zornog, and the King gave them his [[Sooman starship|fastest starship]] to use to ferry the Prince back to his furious father. En route, C-3PO was vexed when Plooz began devouring [[Neuvian sundae]]s from the ship's [[Food synthesizer/Legends|food synthesizer]], but panicked when a graver threat appeared: battleships of General Sludd. C-3PO hailed the vessels and informed them that Plooz was aboard, but Sludd prepared to attack anyway. The protocol droid ordered R2-D2 to prepare the ship's hyperdrive, and Plooz, hoping to help, inadvertently disrupted the ship's [[antimatter]] pods. With [[electron torpedo]]es incoming, C-3PO ordered his counterpart to jump to hyperspace regardless. [[File:PloozAntimatter.png|thumb|left|250px|The antimatter pods of the droids' vessel are disrupted, opening a time warp in nearby outer space.]] Aware that there were no [[Star/Legends|stars]] to be seen in the midst of a bright pink opening that surrounded the ship, C-3PO was surprised to learn from R2-D2 that their ship had created a [[Time travel/Legends|time warp]] by causing an antimatter overload upon jumping to hyperspace. After rocketing through the [[Endor Gate/Legends|Endor Gate]] they had created, the ship traveled years into the future and into the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. C-3PO restrained a wailing Plooz from dashing for an escape pod, but he lost control of the child when attempting to give instructions to R2-D2. As Plooz's pod made its way towards the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], C-3PO and R2-D2 landed the ship to give chase. On the moon, they met with [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] Princess and the daughter of [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] of the Ewok's [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], who spoke an [[Ewokese/Legends|obscure dialect]] of the [[Inner Zuma Region|Inner Zuma]] that C-3PO understood. Kneesaa brought them to a peace summit occurring between Chirpa's [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|Council of Elders]] and King [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] of the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]], another [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species native to the moon. Gorneesh was holding a terrified Plooz over a chasm, and C-3PO demanded that he be let go. Just then, rays from Endor's primary star [[Ibleam]] reflected off of C-3PO's plating, giving him the glowing appearance of what the Duloks perceived to be an Ewok demon. The Duloks fled, and Ploz was rescued from the chasm by R2-D2 and the Ewok [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]].[[Ewoks (1985) 10|''Ewoks'' (1985) 10]] After the Ewoks escorted the droids and Plooz back to their Sooman craft, the trio piloted the ship through the Endor Gate seconds before it closed, and returned to their own time. Sludd's fleet remained where they had left it and fired on them, but C-3PO took control of the situation and directed R2-D2 to land the damaged craft outside Gokus's palace. As Plooz entered the palace to find his father, Sludd landed his own ship and held the two droids at gunpoint. When Gokus arrived, demanding an explanation from his general, R2-D2 played a recording of Sludd's earlier threat to kill Plooz and seize control of both Alzar and Sooma. Livid, Gokus had his general and his co-conspirators thrown in [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. C-3PO and R2-D2 remained in Zornog's service, but the fidgety king quickly tired of their constant bickering. The last straw came when R2-D2 inadvertently shorted out the palace's power system, and the droids were abandoned on the planet of [[R-Duba]]. They made their way to [[The Droid Store]] of businessman [[Van P. Quist]].[[Droids (1986) 5|''Droids'' (1986) 5]] When R2-D2 was purchased by the human [[Kirk Windjammer]], C-3PO found a new owner of his own after Baron [[Gavern Starlock]] bought him to serve as a translator for R-Duba's Prince [[Jagoda]]. Starlock soon betrayed his Prince by helping the people of [[Dorande]] attempt to conquer R-Duba, but found his efforts thwarted by C-3PO, R2-D2, and Windjammer. In the process, C-3PO stopped Starlock's droid [[BX-00]] from [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] the Prince. Reunited, the droids left Jagoda's court and suggested that Windjammer be appointed Jagoda's Chief Advisor. Continuing their journey through the stars, C-3PO and R2-D2 stowed away aboard a ship headed for [[Ord Gertoth]]. ====Troubles with Tig Fromm==== {{Quote|Oh what a perilous chain of events! We're lost in a game of chance to a new master who turns out to be a smuggler, then we're tossed overboard with the stolen goods whilst he gets himself arrested.|C-3PO, regarding himself and R2-D2|{{DroidsCite|The White Witch}}}} C-3PO and R2-D2 were kicked off of the ship, however, at a [[Sindee's refueling station|one-woman refueling station]] operated by a [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimm]] businesswoman named [[Sindee]]. As their new master, Sindee taught R2-D2 how to play [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]], but her gambling addiction saw her lose both droids to the smuggler [[Zevel Hortine]] in a game of [[Liar's Cut/Legends|Liar's Cut]]. In the year [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} Hortine jettisoned a large amount of contraband from his ship while being arrested above the planet [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]]. The droids were in the ship's cargo bay at the time. After landing in the planet's [[Vaj Desert]], the droids trekked across the sands before being spotted by two [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] jockeys, [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] and [[Jord Dusat]]. Having been in search of an R2 unit, the two declared themselves the new masters of the droid duo and welcomed them into Joben's [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]]. While traveling to their auto-shop, the jockeys crossed into the desert's restricted zone and were pursued by [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|seeker probe droids]]; the chase saw C-3PO fall from Joben's speeder and land in the desert's sands, where he was accosted by a large [[Droid tank/Legends|droid tank]]. Throwing a rock at it, the protocol droid was surprised to see it explode. Unbeknownst to him, the [[Fromm Tower Droid]] had actually been [[Mission to Ingo|destroyed]] by [[Kea Moll]], a young resistance fighter from [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]] who had made her way to Ingo. With the seekers successfully evaded, the jockeys brought the droids back to their shop. C-3PO and R2-D2 helped fix up Joben and Dusat's speeders and were shown the ''[[White Witch]]'', a heavily modified [[C/L-82 landspeeder|speeder]] that the jockeys intended to enter into an upcoming race with R2-D2 flying in its [[Astromech socket/Legends|droid socket]]. Joben then left the shop for the night and brought the droids with him, but noticed pursuit by an unknown party and hid his speeder accordingly. With the pursuers dodged, the trio returned to the shop, only to find that Dusat had been kidnapped. Following the arrival of Kea Moll, who had been seeking a mechanic, R2-D2's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detected movement outside. Investigating, Joben discovered that his speeder had been sabotaged, and soon found himself surrounded by hostile droids. C-3PO, R2-D2, and Moll took the ''White Witch'' outside and saved Joben, before tracking the droids to a [[Tig Fromm's base|base]] belonging to Tig Fromm, the Anoo-Dat gangster that C-3PO and R2-D2 had previously encountered while in the service of Lonn Idd. [[File:White_Witch_attacked.jpg|thumb|right|275px|The ''White Witch'' is attacked by seeker probe droids.]] After R2-D2 infiltrated the base, a Fromm Tower Droid opened the complex's doors in an effort to locate the intruder. It was swiftly decapitated by the ''White Witch'', which zoomed into the open doors and made its way through a cave system after locating Dusat on a map of the base. After coming to a locked door, Joben cut his way through with a lightsaber that a customer had previously left him, before taking R2-D2 in the ''White Witch'' through the base's tube system to rescue Dusat. Remaining at the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that displayed the map, C-3PO and Moll monitored Joben's progress and redirected tube traffic out of his way. Their efforts were nearly thwarted by a [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol droid]] and a maintenance droid, but C-3PO tricked the two into inadvertently destroying each other. The protocol droid's cunning continued as he directed all patrol droids away from the ''Witch'' over a loudspeaker, and convinced two more of the units that he was their ally and had captured Moll. After rescuing Dusat, Joben and R2-D2 recovered C-3PO and Moll, and piloted the speeder to the base's exit, only to find several [[droid cruiser]]s waiting outside and firing at them. C-3PO located a computer and overrode orders from Tig Fromm that had deactivated several tower droids; the reactivated tanks battled the cruisers, allowing the ''White Witch'' to escape in the confusion. Joben destroyed several seeker probes that attempted to follow it, before taking the speeder was to Moll's [[Starrunner-class starship|ship]], the ''[[Sand Sloth]]'', where Moll, the droids, and their masters prepared to take the ''Witch'' to the [[Boonta Speeder Race]]. Aboard the ship, C-3PO and R2-D2 held a discussion regarding speeder racing before the ship jumped to the [[Annoo system/Legends|Annoo system]]. Following the jump, the droids made their way to the ship's hull to enact repairs. C-3PO and the ship's hyperdrive began to float away, but R2-D2 wheeled the protocol droid back towards the ship via a [[Rope/Legends|rope]] that C-3PO had attached himself to. C-3PO's servomotors seized up when R2-D2 attempted to keep him stuck to the hull, temporarily locking his torso in a position perpendicular to his legs. The crew of the ''Sand Sloth'' needed a new hyperdrive, and traveled to Annoo to find one.{{DroidsCite|Escape Into Terror}} Following a scuffle with another droid at Annoo customs, C-3PO and R2-D2 spotted two members of the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] and caused a scene, offering a distraction that allowed their human companions to escape. Joben, Dusat, and Moll took the droids to the home of Kea's mother [[Demma Moll|Demma]], where C-3PO and R2-D2 performed various chores while their masters slept. After a [[sand sloth]] knocked him into a wall, C-3PO unintentionally activated a secret door leading to a rebel base of the [[Annoo resistance]]. When the droids went to wake Joben up and inform him of their discovery, they found an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] spraying the jockey with gas. A brief skirmish ensued that concluded with Moll arriving and shooting the assassin; her mother promptly arrived home and informed her guests that [[Sise Fromm]], the leader of the Fromm gang, was trying to kill Joben and Dusat for having discovered his secret base on Ingo. In that base, the Fromm gang was developing a secret and deadly [[Superweapon/Legends|weapons satellite]] called the ''[[Trigon One]]''. When the humans returned to their slumber, C-3PO prepared himself for an eventual confrontation with the Fromms by practicing [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]], but found the endeavor taxing when his servomotors seized up again. {{Unlicensedstart}} Tig Fromm moved the ''Trigon One'' into hiding among Ingo's desert cliffs at some point, and Joben and Dusat intercepted a transmission between Tig and his father that revealed as much.
